regression: Photo bank checker passed for all 174 verified local JPGs.
Local renderer removes the unrelated fixture from the Olympiacos caption, preserves archive label and visible credit, and keeps the original Partizan article's image binding.
Only four contextual text fields of this asset changed; JPG/hash/license/source and editorial approvals were preserved.
release_blocker: Existing source checkout is readable and reconciled to the production version plus owner receipt, but normal Git remote read returned no usable username/credential in this execution. No new source credential was issued under the cycle's no-keys mandate; patch was not pushed and no lease or deployment was started.
